basis_codes.closed-form: A sample-level expectation is derivable from the frozen 78 normalized parameters and the pinned mapping/stage equations alone, without executing TorchSynth. Residual disagreement against a float32 reference is rounding, judged by a declared error metric that this document does not supply.
basis_codes.closed-form-limited: A mathematical expectation exists but depends on accumulated float32 state (oscillator phase under modulation, chained products) or on an input whose own basis is limited. Usable for the listed property-level truths, never as a sample-level oracle.
basis_codes.reference-capture-only: No expectation exists without the pinned reference: a seeded pseudorandom stream, or a whole-clip extremum with no closed form. Only the listed structural or distributional facts are analytic.

analytically_silent.consequence: mixer.pre_normalization and mixer.output are identically zero, mixer.peak is zero, mixer.gain is one by the derived rule, and the normalization division is not applied. Final-output truth is closed-form for these fixtures.
analytically_silent.limit: Analytic but non-discriminating: a candidate that emits silence for an unrelated reason matches the same expectation. These fixtures qualify parameter deactivation, not audio fidelity.
analytically_silent.rule: For every audio source, the mixer gain is zero or its destination amplitude column in the modulation matrix is entirely zero.

noise_audible.consequence: mixer.pre_normalization, mixer.output, mixer.peak and mixer.gain are reference-capture-only for these fixtures, because the audible samples are the pinned seeded stream.
noise_audible.limit: Reproducing the stream with a second copy of the pinned source is repeatability, not analytic truth.
noise_audible.rule: mixer.noise is greater than zero and at least one mod_matrix.<source>->noise_amp weight is greater than zero.

normalization_targets.consequence: The three declared exact binary32 peak targets are design intents. The branch decision (strict peak greater than one, tie retains the input) is analytic; the peak that selects the branch is not.
normalization_targets.limit: A candidate patch that misses its target peak leaves the branch uncovered; no tolerance or gain fitting may promote it.
normalization_targets.rule: The fixture is one of normalization:below, normalization:tie or normalization:above.

limits: This document classifies where an expectation can come from. It declares no tolerance, no error metric, no estimator qualification and no rubric.
A closed-form basis is an availability statement, not a claim that any expectation has been computed, qualified, or compared.
Property-level analytic truth requires a separately qualified estimator; the landed periodic and envelope qualifications are analytic-development-only.
Classification is reviewed judgement over the landed trace registry, not a generated result. Drift from it is an error to reconcile, never a value to update silently.
scope: Availability of analytic (non-reference) truth for the 32 canonical trace names when exercised by the preregistered directed Voice fixtures. Sample-level basis plus the property-level truths that a later qualified estimator could ground analytically.

adsr_1.output.condition: Stage times follow the pinned ADSR equations from the frozen parameters and the note-off implied by keyboard.duration at the 441 Hz control rate.

adsr_2.output.condition: Same basis as adsr_1.output; the directed manifest drives both envelopes independently of the modulation matrix.

control_upsample.noise_amp.condition: Endpoint-aligned interpolation is exact algebra on its input, so the basis is inherited from mod_matrix.noise_amp; the endpoint and count facts are analytic regardless.

control_upsample.vco_1_amp.condition: Inherited from mod_matrix.vco_1_amp; endpoints and sample count are analytic.

control_upsample.vco_1_pitch.condition: Inherited from mod_matrix.vco_1_pitch; endpoints and sample count are analytic.

control_upsample.vco_2_amp.condition: Inherited from mod_matrix.vco_2_amp; endpoints and sample count are analytic.

control_upsample.vco_2_pitch.condition: Inherited from mod_matrix.vco_2_pitch; endpoints and sample count are analytic.

keyboard.duration.condition: A pinned parameter conversion of the frozen normalized input.

keyboard.midi_f0.condition: A pinned parameter conversion of the frozen normalized input.

lfo_1.post_control_vca.condition: A product of lfo_1.raw and lfo_1_amp_adsr.output; inherits the raw LFO's phase accumulation.

lfo_1.raw.condition: The five-shape blend is analytic at a fixed rate, but lfo_1_rate_adsr modulates the rate, so the sample-level expectation depends on float32 phase accumulation.

lfo_1_amp_adsr.output.condition: Pinned ADSR equations from the frozen parameters.

lfo_1_rate_adsr.output.condition: Pinned ADSR equations from the frozen parameters.

lfo_2.post_control_vca.condition: A product of lfo_2.raw and lfo_2_amp_adsr.output; inherits the raw LFO's phase accumulation.

lfo_2.raw.condition: Same basis as lfo_1.raw under lfo_2_rate_adsr modulation.

lfo_2_amp_adsr.output.condition: Pinned ADSR equations from the frozen parameters.

lfo_2_rate_adsr.output.condition: Pinned ADSR equations from the frozen parameters.

mixer.gain.condition: Derived from mixer.peak by the declared rule, so it inherits the extremum. The branch decision and the reciprocal rule are analytic; the value that selects the branch is measured. Closed-form only for analytically silent fixtures.

mixer.output.condition: Inherits mixer.pre_normalization and mixer.gain. Closed-form only for analytically silent fixtures; reference-capture-only whenever the noise path is audible.

mixer.peak.condition: A whole-clip extremum over 176,400 modulated samples has no closed form; the landed fixture spec already requires capture. Closed-form only for analytically silent fixtures.

mixer.pre_normalization.condition: A weighted sum of the three post-VCA sources: closed-form-limited when only oscillator paths are audible, reference-capture-only whenever the noise path is audible, and closed-form (identically zero) for analytically silent fixtures.

mod_matrix.noise_amp.condition: A weighted sum of the four control sources; closed-form when only envelope inputs are routed, and the 20 isolated-route fixtures make that condition explicit.

mod_matrix.vco_1_amp.condition: As mod_matrix.noise_amp for the vco_1 amplitude column.

mod_matrix.vco_1_pitch.condition: As mod_matrix.noise_amp for the vco_1 pitch column.

mod_matrix.vco_2_amp.condition: As mod_matrix.noise_amp for the vco_2 amplitude column.

mod_matrix.vco_2_pitch.condition: As mod_matrix.noise_amp for the vco_2 pitch column.

noise.post_vca.condition: A product of the seeded stream and its upsampled control; identically zero exactly when the noise_amp column is deactivated, and otherwise carries the stream.

noise.raw.condition: A seeded pseudorandom stream (slot 0, seed 13). Regenerating it from a second copy of the pinned source is repeatability, not analytic truth; only distributional facts are analytic.

vco_1.post_vca.condition: A product of vco_1.raw and its upsampled amplitude control; inherits oscillator phase accumulation.

vco_1.raw.condition: A sine whose instantaneous frequency follows the upsampled pitch control; the sample-level expectation depends on float32 phase accumulation.

vco_2.post_vca.condition: A product of vco_2.raw and its upsampled amplitude control; inherits oscillator phase accumulation.

vco_2.raw.condition: A square/saw shape blend over an accumulated modulated phase; the shape regime at a frozen vco_2.shape is analytic, the samples are not.
